correctness.summary: The Erdős--Faudree--Ordman cut inequality gives the claimed lower bound. Optimal edge-colorings of K_r and K_s schedule edge-disjoint K4s for all smaller-side internal edges and triangles for all surplus larger-side internal edges; the resulting count meets the bound. The covering number is forced by an induced representative K_{h,h}. A standalone verifier checks 90 parameter cases.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Ning (2026) gives the symmetric formula only for even k. Erdős--Faudree--Ordman (1988) supplies the general cut lower bound but not this exact joined-cluster family, while Caccetta--Erdős--Ordman--Pullman (1985) covers the independent-side boundary r=1. Searches did not locate the asymmetric r,s>=2 formula or the odd symmetric extension. Broad older literature under different terminology is the principal residual risk.

value.summary: The theorem exactly determines both clique parameters for a natural two-parameter extension of the construction behind the new n^{4/3} deficit result, removes its parity restriction, and exhibits a reusable sharpness mechanism combining K4 and triangle packing.

limitations: The condition h>=chi'(K_s) is sufficient and may not be necessary.
The theorem assumes the same number h of clusters on both sides.
The r=1 boundary is already covered by older work and is not an originality claim.
Finite verification supports the explicit construction only.
Independent audit has not been performed.
